function f(k: string) {
  const o: { [key: string]: (n: number) => number } = { [k]: (n) => n + 1 };
  console.log(o[k](1));
  const m: { [key: number]: (s: string) => number } = { [k.length]: (s) => s.length };
  console.log(m[k.length]("abc"));
}
f("x");
function g(k: "x" | "y") {
  const o = { [k]: "hello" } as const;
  const x: "hello" = o.x;
  console.log(x, o);
}
g("x");
